"""Sensitivity of the validity rule (paper-repo request, experiment-repo#11). No new runs: reads results/cells.csv and headline.csv.

Strict rule (the one the delivered tables use): an interval is valid if the Wilson upper limit of its coverage is >= 0.95
and, for arms other than PPI++, its coverage is not below PPI++'s beyond Monte-Carlo error (paired test).
Loose rule: the Wilson test is replaced by a point-estimate threshold, coverage >= LOOSE (default 0.94); the paired test is kept.
